# Data Examples

表格和复杂数据组件先定义列、数据和 key，再处理分页、选择、展开等增强项。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## Collapse

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/collapse/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/collapse/`.

Note: `onChange` / `v-model:activeKey` 永远是数组，空是 `[]`。accordion 多键只留最后一项。`1` 与 `"1"` 同一面板。header 是真 button；extra 是兄弟，不进可访问名。

Vue: `<Collapse :active-key="keys"><CollapsePanel panel-key="1" header="FAQ">Answer</CollapsePanel></Collapse>`

React: `<Collapse activeKey={keys}><CollapsePanel panelKey="1" header="FAQ">Answer</CollapsePanel></Collapse>`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
